秦书简说完那话后，似是意识到了自己的唐突，又开了口：“不好意思，我好像打扰到你们了。”不知是谁接了句：“没关系。”紧接着又有人接了句：“你就是秦书简呀，能不能跟我合个影，签个名？”包厢里一下子又喧哗了起来，不过绝大多数都是在围着秦书简转。夏晚安仿佛没事的人一般，又闭上了眼睛，不过这次她却没像刚刚那样睡着。没多久，夏晚安的身边传来了一道浓郁的香水味，她皱了皱鼻子，往旁边看了一眼，秦书简不知何时坐在了自己旁边，正侧着身跟韩经年说话。她不过只是看了一眼，宋有蔓就掐了她腰肢一下：“晚安，你不是陪我去洗手间吗？走呀……”说着，宋有蔓都没等她有所反应，就起身，拽着她的胳膊，把她揪出了包厢。往前走了一段距离，夏晚安发现宋有蔓带自己走的压根不是去洗手间的路：“不是去洗手间吗？”“去什么洗手间！你是真不懂我的用意，还是装不懂？”宋有蔓恨铁不成钢的瞪了一眼夏晚安。夏晚安咧嘴傻笑了一下。她当然知道有蔓只是找了个借口，把她从那个尴尬的处境里带走而已，不过……想着，夏晚安开口问把她拽进电梯里的宋有蔓：“你这是要带我去哪里？”“去吃宵夜！”宋有蔓说着，就按了地下停车场的楼层数。“宵夜？”“怎么？不想吃？那……spa？”spa，可以睡……夏晚安点头：“好的。”两人去了她们常去的spa会所，美美的泡了个澡后，两人在技师纯熟的指法按摩下，逐渐放松了身心。夏晚安没一会儿，就睡过去了，但宋有蔓却怎么都睡不着，然后开始喊夏晚安，喊到最后，见夏晚安睡的不省人事，忍无可忍的起身拍了夏晚安一把，把她从梦中打醒，然后气嗖嗖的开口说：“夏晚安，都这样了，你还有心情睡？”夏晚安迷迷蒙蒙的揉了揉眼睛，不满的嘀咕了句：“都怎样了？”“你说呢？！”夏晚安没了声音。宋有蔓怒其不争的又开了口：“你别跟我说，今天你见到的那个女人，心底就没想法？”那个女人……夏晚安知道，宋有蔓指的是秦书简……她没说话，但眼睛却睁开了。“我问你，你多久没见他了？他知道他有个家，有个老婆吗？晚安，你难道就没想过以后吗？你该不会就打算以现在这个状态跟他过一辈子吧？好吧，就算是你想，那他呢？他要是遇到个自己喜欢的，非要跟你离婚，你怎么办？”宋有蔓说了很长的一段话，见夏晚安没动静，又开了口：“晚安？晚安？夏晚安，你在听我说话吗？”“听着呢……”夏晚安动了动唇。“那我刚刚说的那些，你是怎么想的？”“嗯……”夏晚安沉吟了一会儿，“我就是想，今晚的事，你烂在肚子里，别对着我爸妈和你爸妈说，要不然他们要担心了。”

After Qin Shujian said that, he seemed to be aware of his abruptness and said again: "Sorry, I seem to have disturbed you." I don't know who answered: "It's okay." Then someone else added: "You are Qin Shujian, can you take a photo with me and sign your name?" The box suddenly became noisy again, but most of them were surrounding Qin Shujian. Xia Wan'an closed her eyes again as if she was fine, but this time she didn't fall asleep like she did just now. Not long after, a strong smell of perfume came from Xia Wan'an's side. She wrinkled her nose and glanced to the side. Qin Shujian was sitting next to her at some point and was talking to Han Jingnian sideways. She just glanced at her, and Song Youman pinched her waist: "Good night, didn't you accompany me to the bathroom? Let's go..." After saying that, Song Youman stood up without waiting for her to react, grabbed her arm, and pulled her out of the box. After walking a certain distance, Xia Wan'an realized that the way Song Youman took her was not the way to the bathroom at all: "Aren't you going to the bathroom?" "Which bathroom? Do you really don't understand my intention, or are you pretending not to understand?" Song Youman glared at Xia Wan'an with hatred. Xia Wan'an grinned stupidly. Of course she knew that Youman just made an excuse to take her away from that embarrassing situation, but... thinking about it, Xia Wan'an asked Song Youman who dragged her into the elevator: "Where are you taking me?" "To have a midnight snack!" Song Youman said and pressed the floor number of the underground parking lot. "Supper?" "What? Don't want to eat? Then... spa?" Spa, you can sleep... Xia Wan'an nodded: "Okay." The two went to the spa club where they often go. After taking a nice bath, they gradually relaxed their body and mind under the skilled finger massage of the technician. After a while, Xia Wan'an fell asleep, but Song Youman couldn't fall asleep no matter what. Then he started to call Xia Wan'an good night. At the end of the shouting, seeing Xia Wan'an sleeping unconscious, he couldn't bear to get up and patted Xia Wan'an, waking her up from her dream. , and then said angrily: "Good night Xia, after everything is like this, are you still in the mood to sleep?" Xia Wan'an rubbed his eyes in confusion, and muttered dissatisfied: "What happened?" "What do you think?!" Xia Wan'an lost his voice. Song Youman spoke again angrily: "Don't tell me that the woman you saw today didn't have any thoughts in her heart?" That woman... Xia Wan'an knew that Song Youman was referring to Qin Shujian... She didn't speak, but her eyes opened. "Let me ask you, how long have you not seen him? Does he know that he has a family and a wife? Good night, haven't you ever thought about the future? Are you planning to live with him in this state for the rest of your life? Well, even if you want to, what about him? If he meets What should you do if you find someone you like and insist on divorcing you?" Song Youman said for a long time. Seeing that Xia Wan'an didn't move, he spoke again: "Good night? Good night, Xia Wan'an, are you listening to me?" "Listen..." Xia Wan'an moved her lips. "Then what do you think about what I just said?" "Well..." Xia Wan'an pondered for a while, "I just think that if you are rotten in your stomach about what happened tonight, don't tell my parents and your parents, otherwise they will worry."
